entries.notes: All 28 TypeScript declarations are translated directly. Coverage preserves stable terminal categories for replay corruption, event limits, divergence, runtime/deployment/user errors, backend contract failures, transport errors, throttling, native OperationError, and non-Error throws. Retry classification keeps 429, 5xx, TRANSPORT, and TIMEOUT retryable while making 4xx, parse/schema violations, TooEarly pacing, plain values, and permanently lost event payloads terminal. WF-RUST-020 records the read-amplification and availability consequence of retrying an unrecoverable payload. Final GREEN must dispatch on the real Rust error enum/typed World metadata and may not infer categories from untrusted message text.
